msg: Hello, I'm French, I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 4 nights. I'm an Open Water diver (last dive in March). Can I dive two days in a row from here? How much?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes! You can dive on two consecutive days from Isla Grande. Since your last dive was in March, the refresher requirement only applies if it has been more than two years since your last dive.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

Both plans include equipment, insurance, and a PADI professional. Lunch isn’t included, and hotel pick-up depends on whether your hotel has boat access.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you prefer daytime dives only, or a night dive too?

msg: I'm staying at San Pedro de Majagua. I'd like 2 dives on Wednesday and 2 dives on Thursday. Is there a package for two days? How do I book?
reply:
Yes! There’s a two-day package with 4 daytime dives, and San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels with pickup included. The online price is 204 USD per person; the regular price is 227 USD per person. Lunch isn’t included.

You can book through the website, where you choose the date and number of people. For a next-day booking, the system closes at 4:30 PM the day before. [Book the 4-dive package](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en)

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: Just me, 1 person. How do I book the 2-day package from the islands?
reply:
You can book through the website by selecting your date and one person. The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before; for the next day, booking must be made before then. [Book the 2-day, 4-dive package](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en)

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
